meta.title: Undertow — a club night on Mētis
meta.description: A monthly club night in a Leeds basement on the new Mētis theme in its black-and-white Cimmeria style: a flyer made of type, the night as a two-room timetable, the next dates as big numbers and the house rules.
meta.author: jamiemarsland
